rows.note: Use 折扣 as the all-purpose noun for a reduction in the selling price.

example.english: This shirt is on discount now, so it’s much cheaper.
example.traditional: 呢件衫而家有折扣，平好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 ji4 gaa1 jau5 zit3 kau3 ping4 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use 貼現 for the financial deduction made when advancing money against a bill or note before it is due.

example.english: The bank will deduct the discount interest before the bill comes due.
example.traditional: 呢張票據未到期，銀行會先扣除貼現利息。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 piu3 geoi3 mei6 dou3 kei4 ngan4 hong4 wui5 sin1 kau3 ceoi4 tip3 jin6 lei6 sik1
